entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner is facing trial before the court of the learned J.M.F.C., Soro in the district of Balasore in C.T. Case No.311 of 2009 under Sections 420/294/307/506(II) of the IPC.
He was admitted to bail by this Court vide order dated 12.04.2010 passed in BLAPL No.5788 of 2010.
2. After having obtained bail from this Court, the petitioner appears to have avoided appearance before the trial court as a result of which the trial was stalled.
Eventually on 22.01.2013, the learned trial court issued N.B.W. against the petitioner.
The said order is under challenge.
Even though the N.B.W. was issued on 22.01.2013, the same has not been executed.

Therefore, on 31.07.2023 the court below initiated the proceeding under Sections 82/83 Cr.P.C.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner would surrender to the jurisdiction of the court below forthwith.
Therefore, the operation of the order dated 22.01.2013 may be stayed.

4. Since the petitioner has approached this Court after one decade of issuance of N.B.W. against him, he is liable to pay a cost of Rs.2,500/- to the Welfare Fund of the High Court Bar Association,
Cuttack.
5. Subject to paying the cost of Rs.2,500/-, the order dated 22.01.2023 is set aside.
The petitioner is directed to surrender to the jurisdiction of the trial court and cooperate with the trial court for speedy disposal of the trial.
He may do so within a period of three weeks hence.
